messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 95p/99p latency and repeated OOMs on continuous-batcher pool cw-3. KV cache size growing unusually fast (delta > 40GB/10m). Affects text-gen and stream-gen in us-west2. Root ts=1772008888

pagerduty-bot: paging alex (oncall) 1: escalation level 2. Notifying eng-oncall channel.

alex: Im on it, pulling recent config diffs and control-plane audit. Spawning tails on hosts cw-3-{01..12}.

jordan: seeing lots of eviction churn in the runtime logs: `evict_policy: lru, evicted=1200/s` and many large `kvcache.insert` sizes.

ritu: quick config diff: templated batch profile `rbatch-prod` got merged in the automated rollout pipeline 9m ago. The template mistakenly multiplied token_window by 32 due to a math bug in the deploy script, setting `continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens=131072` (previous value 4096).

maria: that explains huge scheduled batches. Large batches -> enormous prefix caching -> eviction storms -> GC pressure -> latency spikes. We need a rapid containment plan.

alex: agreed. Immediate steps: (1) enable batching circuit-breaker for cw-3 (turn off continuous batching), (2) apply conservative overrides: max_batch_tokens=4096, max_num_seqs=8, batching.timeout_ms=40, (3) throttle kvcache insert rate via kvcache.write_qps=200. We'll do ring-scoped changes to avoid global blast.

ritu: applying ring-scoped breaker now. Command:```bash
http POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/configs scope:=ring:us-west2:pool:cw-3 path:=continuous_batch.enabled value:=false Authorization:"Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

ritu: and putting conservative overrides (rolling 3 hosts at a time):```bash
http POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/configs scope:=ring:us-west2:pool:cw-3 path:=continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens value:=4096
http POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/configs scope:=ring:us-west2:pool:cw-3 path:=continuous_batch.max_num_seqs value:=8
http POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/configs scope:=ring:us-west2:pool:cw-3 path:=batching.timeout_ms value:=40
```

alex: starting rollout. I'll watch mem/latency. If any host still trips >90% mem, mark it for replacement and divert traffic.

jordan: enabling runtime safety net too: cap_effective_max_batch_tokens=8192 enforced at runtime for now. That will prevent a bad config from immediately exploding.

cs-liz: CS: were seeing customer reports of degraded streaming quality and some aborted streams. Which customers are impacted?

maria: quick count: ~9 paying customers saw tail latencies >3s and 3 customers had transient 504s during the peak (window ~10m). No data loss. Ill open an incident notice to CS and attach mitigation timeline.

ritu: first 3 hosts rolled: mem usage drop ~28%, error rate down 60%, 95p latency improving from 2.4s -> 380ms on rolled hosts.

alex: handoff: I need to step into an exec sync for 20m. Maria, can you own the channel and finish the rollout? Ill keep my phone on.

maria: taking over. Continuing rolling updates, will keep batching disabled until all hosts are stable.

jordan: monitoring note: KV cache eviction rate peaked at 2.4k/s and then subsided as hosts rolled. Observed total_kvcache_bytes reduced from 140GB -> 42GB across cw-3 after 16m.

pagerduty-bot: mitigation status: partial (hotfix applied to 6/12 hosts), improvements observed.

ritu: after completing full rollout and re-enabling batching with conservative caps, we did a staged re-enable: turned on continuous_batch.enabled=true on 2 hosts and observed for 5 minutes before enabling more. No regressions.

maria: customer impact summary for CS: window 02:12-02:30 UTC, 9 customers affected by high latency, 3 customers saw transient 504s; top-tier customers contacted. No PII exposure.

alex: creating follow-up: INC-2026-189. Root cause: automation math bug + missing upper-bound validation for continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens. Remediations: (A) fix deploy script math and add unit tests, (B) add control-plane schema validation with absolute max per model family, (C) runtime hard cap that ignores values > X, (D) safety: two-approver requirement for ring-scoped changes that modify batch caps by >4x.

jordan: also propose a smoke test post-deploy that simulates a burst schedule and validates kvcache delta under a threshold.

maria: I'll file PRs for (B) and (D) and coordinate with infra to add runtime caps. Ill also draft a short blurb for CS; cs-liz, can you review?

cs-liz: yes, will review and send customer-facing note within the hour.

alex: logs for postmortem:```text
2026-03-15T03:14:02Z WARN batcher: merged_batch_tokens=120960, seqs=96
2026-03-15T03:14:10Z ERROR kvcache: insert_size=67108864 total_cache=140GB
2026-03-15T03:20:45Z INFO controlplane: rollout override applied ring:us-west2:pool:cw-3 continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens=4096
```

maria: monitoring: 95p latency stable and back to baseline at 03:28 UTC. Memory pressure cleared by 03:31 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated. Please assign INC-2026-189 to eng-infra + eng-runtime for postmortem and remediation.

jordan: follow-ups logged in ticket: add unit tests for deploy scripts, control-plane schema guard, runtime cap, staged re-enable playbook.

maria: will do a +1h verification pass and post results. Leaving the channel if no regressions.

incident-bot: Thread closed (mitigated). Follow-up: INC-2026-189.
